content.value: An engine operating on air standard diesel cycle, the percentage clearance is 6.25% and at the beginning of isentropic compression, the temperature is 26°C and the pressure is 0.1 MPa. Heat is added until the temperature at the end of constant pressure is 1650°C. Calculate – (i) compression ratio; (ii) cut off ratio; (iii) heat added and (iv) heat rejected.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2020
